name: One drop riddim
desc: Roots-reggae one drop in the Carlton Barrett style: kick and cross-stick land together on beat 3 with beats 1 and 2 left open, shuffled hi-hats via triplet elongation, and a rim-shot double at phrase ends. Peak moves to a rockers kick with open-hat accents.

code.full: stack(s("~ ~ [bd,rim] ~").gain(${gain}).shape(.45), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").gain("[.4 .26]*4").hpf(sine.range(5000,8000).slow(16)), s("sh*4").gain(.16).late(.02), s("~ ~ ~ <~ ~ ~ [rim rim]>").gain(.4).room(.5)).room(${room}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ [bd,rim] ~] [bd ~ [bd,rim] [~ bd]]>").gain(${gain}).shape(.5), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").gain("[.45 .3]*4").hpf(5200), s("~ oh ~ oh").gain(.28), s("sh*8").gain("[.2 .12]*4"), s("~ ~ ~ <~ [rim rim ~] ~ [~ rim rim]>").gain(.45).room(.5)).room(${room}).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
